description: Save language/session metadata using the same content validators as the human save route. An absent roster is initialized with server-generated starters for free. Submitted creatures are structurally validated (max 200) but never replace the server-owned roster; stats, equipment, tickets and balances cannot be minted or edited here. Create a new entity with forge_summon; modify it with forge_fusion or forge_reroll. No reset endpoint: the human reset is admin-only and deletes locked funds.

creatures.description: Optional human save payload: validated, then ignored in favor of server-owned creatures.
